d: A fleet of UFOs are filmed over the South China Sea - how do they seem to be able to blink in and out of existence? A 12,000-year-old archaeological site reveals carvings of alien-like, six-fingered humanoids.

Did a man capture on film a UFO crash in Brazil, moments after an aerial firefight with government forces? A close encounter of the Beatles kind - John Lennon and his girlfriend May Pang say they saw a UFO from their balcony.

A UFO is captured flying straight from the sky and into the sea with no loss of speed - stunning beachgoers in Indonesia. Astronaut Neil Armstrong joins a search in the Ecuadorian jungle for an ancient alien library.

UFOs appear over three of Sweden's power plants, two airports and the Royal Palace. Is the country about to be attacked by some unearthly force? A serviceman who says he encountered a UFO finally receives a medical payout from the US military.

A mysterious craft rises out of the Costa Rican jungle and is captured on camera. Some say it's the best footage of a UFO they've ever seen. But could it also reveal some of the technical secrets behind otherworldy engineering?

A man in Missouri films what looks like a metal cube spinning in the sky. Something very similar is seen elsewhere. Could it be the same UFO or are there multiple unidentified flying cubes hovering over the American continent?

A mysterious opening caught on camera on the Red Planet – could this be a gateway to a base on Mars? A UFO appears to invade an Amazon village and leaves a trail of victims – and an unidentified craft gate-crashes the Queen's Jubilee celebration.

A US Navy warship is swarmed by aggressive UFOs – are these signals from space friendly – or a coded threat? A British TV broadcast is interrupted by a voice claiming to be from the Ashtar Gallactic Command and warning that the Earth is in peril.
